correctness.rationale: Kac/Abramov and relative entropy give a unique stationary iid-return maximizer at each 0<t<1/2, including an explicit strict inequality if an all-zero atom occurs. Gaussian Poisson summation gives exact identity (2), rational surrogate mean (3), cubic equation (4), and uniform exponentially small error by variational comparison on s in [t/3,t]. SymPy checks the first two corrections; mpmath direct partition sums corroborate; numerics are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The entropy at fixed marker frequency is a natural invariant of the nonsofic perfect-square-gap shift. The analytic cubic gives all algebraic orders with an exponentially small error, recovering an explicit nonzero square-root lattice correction and sharply contrasting polynomial-gap scaling with geometric-gap log-periodicity and prime-gap asymptotics. It is a mathematically motivated precise invariant rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
